designDecisions: Domain-neutral package iris_project_os/ (22 modules), quality vocabulary borrowed from iris_quality rather than rebuilt (WO §11 'separate domain-neutral package'; §18 'M01 remains quality authority').
Package __all__ derived at import from each module's __all__ (399 names), refusing an ambiguous double-claim or an empty-export module at import rather than hand-copying a second API that drifts.
closure_obligations returns the full blocker set rather than raising, so commit_snapshot reports every missing piece of evidence at once.
Variant merge canonicalises against the axis default; effective choice asserted via resolve_selection.
restore_archive reports damage (RestorationReport) instead of raising, so revival is an informed decision.
The three module-level tables (LIFECYCLE_TABLES, REQUIRED_GATES, EVIDENCE_KINDS) are annotated Mapping (frozen lookup tables), not the mutable global registries §11 forbids.
failuresEncounteredAndFixed: tests/test_m02_domain_neutrality.py first run failed on unverified helper imports (revision_of/closure/snapshot signatures) — replaced with the real m02_kernel_support API: snapshot(production_id=..., klass=...), closure(production_id=..., graph=bound()), closure_obligations.

Neutrality AST mutable-authority scan initially used ast.Assign.value as a target list (TypeError across every module) and over-flagged the three legitimate Mapping-annotated frozen tables; fixed to read ast.Assign.targets and to allow a declared immutable annotation while still rejecting a bare mutable singleton.
SemanticDiff accessor is is_empty, not empty; the borrowed-ladder identity checked against iris_project_os.versions.QualityClass (the package does not re-export it at top level).
Subprocess isolation script referenced sys without importing it — added to the -c script.

tests/test_m02_profiles.py: 34 initial failures against guessed APIs were resolved by measuring the real kernel behaviour first (archive seal/audit/restore contract, merge selection canonicalisation, MergeConflict.resolution being the strategy itself, SnapshotClosureError for cross-production merges, retention-pin liveness, the lifecycle ladder, store ancestor/descendant shapes). No kernel code was changed to satisfy a test.
scopeDeviations: No frozen M02 invariant was weakened. Review corrections strengthened fail-closed semantics and corrected implementation/test mismatches inside the admitted Work Order.
risksAndDeferredWork: Provider ports (Blender/ComfyUI/cloud/database) are boundaries only; their real implementations arrive in later modules and are deliberately not stubbed here (WO §18 'do not implement later-module providers merely to satisfy an interface').

Windows console renders the '§' character in some kernel error strings as mojibake (\ufffd); this is display noise in the terminal, not a data defect — the source files are UTF-8 and the tests match on ASCII substrings.
M01 test files carry 15 pre-existing F401 unused imports (committed before this WO); left untouched as out of scope and not gated by CI.
